sandbachFocus: Sandbach United face a crucial FA Vase first qualifying round tie against Ashby Ivanhoe on Saturday 15 August at 15:00. This cup competition offers an important opportunity for The Bach to progress, coming off the back of their recent midweek 3-2 loss to Foley Meir and the 1-0 home victory against Stafford Town. With both teams on 6 points in the league, Sandbach will be keen to channel that winning form into the cup.
divisionWide: The weekend features several intriguing fixtures across the division. In-form Wolverhampton Casuals, who top the table with 9 points from three wins, host Dawley Town in what appears a mismatch on paper. AFC Bridgnorth, second with 6 points and unbeaten so far, travel away to face Crewe, who sit 12th with just 3 points. Brereton Social (5th, 6 points) face Bilston Town (13th, 3 points) in a fixture the visitors will hope to use as a springboard. Shawbury United, currently 8th with 4 points, welcome Widnes Town (17th, 1 point) in what should favour the hosts. The clash between third-placed Eccleshall and fourth-placed Stafford Town is notable as both teams sit on 6 points but with different form trajectories. New Mills (6th, 6 points) continue their away campaign at Wolverhampton Casuals, presenting a stern test for the newly promoted side.
